title: Self-Healing Governance Policy
description: Policies governing automatic violation detection, analysis, and remediation

constraints.noHealingWithoutAudit: Every healing action must be logged to SelfHealingAuditTrail BEFORE execution

correctionStrategies.description: Log violation to audit trail, generate alert for developer review. Never modify source files.
Log violation, flag file for developer review. May suggest correct pattern in alert.
Log violation, generate refactoring suggestions for breaking up file
Log violation, suggest constitution update to DependencyRules.json

escalationRules.description: HIGH severity violations escalate to Recovery Layer for retry or isolation strategy
CRITICAL severity violations escalate to Recovery Layer for human intervention

patternAnalysis.description: Detect recurring violation patterns and predict future violations

degradationMonitoring.description: Monitor system health proactively, detect degradation trends before critical violation

auditTrail.description: Immutable audit trail of all violation detection, analysis, and healing decisions

recoveryOrchestrator.usage: Delegate HIGH/CRITICAL violations for recovery path selection

runtimeValidationEngine.usage: Process violation stream from continuous validation

governanceAuditLogger.injection: read-only reference to existing audit logger
governanceAuditLogger.usage: Correlate governance decisions with healing actions
